sources.name: User guide to crime statistics for England and Wales: March 2025
sources.semantic_limit: Explains survey and police-recorded-crime scope, notifiable-offence limits and population coverage; methodology only and no parcel score.

sources.name: Quality of police recorded crime statistics for England and Wales
sources.semantic_limit: Independent quality and consistency assessment; force recording accuracy varies and the report does not create parcel-level incident evidence.

sources.publisher: Office for National Statistics / Office for Statistics Regulation
sources.name: Police recorded crime quality improvement action-plan response
sources.semantic_limit: Tracks quality-improvement commitments and oversight; it is governance evidence, not a local risk observation or parcel score.

sources.name: Crime outcomes year to December 2025 data tables
sources.semantic_limit: Outcome and offence-type aggregate reconciliation only; outcomes are not direct incident-location evidence and must not be assigned to parcels.

sources.name: Police Performance Framework first iteration
sources.semantic_limit: National policy and performance expectations only; not an observed local crime measure and excluded from parcel scoring.

sources.name: Hate crime England and Wales year ending March 2025
sources.semantic_limit: Protected-characteristic and force-level aggregate context with known comparability caveats; no person-level fields retained and excluded from parcel scoring.
